questions.question: ‘Ships’ is related to ‘Fleet’ in the same way as ‘Ants’ is related to ‘________’.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Collective Nouns → a count noun that denotes a group of individuals.

__
 
• ‘Ships’ is related to ‘Fleet’ → A group of **ships** sailing together, engaged in the same activity, or under the same ownership is called **Fleet**.

Similarly, 

 
• ‘Ants’ is related to ‘________’ → A group of **ants** is called a **colony**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

**Gaggle: **

This term is primarily used to describe a group of geese that are not in flight; when in flight, they are often referred to as a skein, team, or wedge. Therefore, 'Gaggle' does not relate to ants and is not the correct analogy.

**Herd: **

This term is typically used to refer to a group of large animals, especially hoofed mammals, such as cows, elephants, or deer. Since ants do not fit the category of large animals or the behavior associated with herding, 'Herd' is not the correct analogy for a group of ants.

**Shoal:**

A shoal refers to a group of fish that swim together. Shoals are usually composed of fish of the same species, and the gathering can serve purposes such as social reasons, protection, and efficient foraging. While 'Shoal' suggests a governed, cohesive movement similar to a fleet in water, it is specifically used for fish and not ants, making it incorrect in this analogy.

Hence, '**Colony**' is the correct answer.

questions.question: Which of the following is dimensionless?

__CONCEPT__:

__
 
• The powers to which fundamental quantities must be raised in order to express the given physical quantity are called its dimensions.
 
• A quantity without dimension will usually be a ratio of two quantities with similar dimensions and, hence, cancel out.
 
• Thus, they will have no units.

EXPLANATION__:

 
• **Longitudinal stress:**

 
 
• Longitudinal stress is the stress which acts along the length and its unit is **N/m² or Pascal.**
 
 
 
• **Shear stress: **
 
 
• **​**If the deforming force acts tangentially to the surface of the body, It produces a change in the shape of the body.
 
• This tangential force applied per unit area is called shear stress.
 
• Its unit is ** N/mm2 or MPa. **
 
 
 
• **Deforming force: **
 
 
• **​**Deforming Force An external force applied to a body that changes its size or shape or both is called deforming force.
 
• its unit is** N or kg-m/s².**
 
 
 
• **Longitudinal strain: **
 
 
• **​**The change in the length (ΔL) to the original length (L) of the body is known as longitudinal strain.
 
 

i.e., Longitudinal strain = frac{{{{Delta }}L}}{L}

 
• And since it is a ratio of two lengths, hence it is a **dimensionless **quantity.
